# Tiny Totz Kids Clinic

> Paediatric clinic in Puppalguda, Hyderabad. One location. Consultations with Dr. Shilpa Reddy T.

## Clinic

- Name: Tiny Totz Kids Clinic
- Specialty: Paediatrics
- Doctor: Dr. Shilpa Reddy T
- Role: Consultant Paediatrician & Pediatric Intensivist
- Qualifications: MBBS, DNB Pediatrics, IDPCCM
- Address: 2nd Floor, C Block, DNS Business Hub, Puppalguda, Hyderabad, Telangana 500089, India
- Landmark: Opposite Alanati Restaurant
- Plus code published by the clinic: C928+935
- Phone: +91 7815933120
- WhatsApp: +91 7815933120
- Email: tinytotzkidsofficial@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday-Saturday, 6:00 PM-9:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed
- Website: https://tinytotzclinic.com/

## Services

- Common childhood illnesses
- Vaccination and immunisation guidance
- Newborn care
- Well-child visits
- Nutrition and growth
- Allergies and asthma
- Weight and puberty concerns
- Developmental concerns
- Seizure follow-up after an episode has settled

Vaccination schedules are advised according to the child's age, health status and applicable pediatric recommendations. A fixed schedule is not published.

## Areas

The clinic is in Puppalguda only. Families also visit from Manikonda, Lanco Hills, Khajaguda, Langer House, Narsingi, Kokapet, Financial District and Nanakramguda. Those are not branch addresses.

## Medical note

Information on the website is for general education and does not replace a consultation. Active seizures, trouble breathing, and an unresponsive child need emergency care.
